results.what: Finishing writes a receipt (what changed, evidence, what comes back) and schedules the hooks 1, 7 and 30 days out

rec: **What changed:** Spot when your future self will want something your present self does not, and build a constraint that holds.
**Evidence:** predictions before the explanation 0/1 · after it, used in new cases 3/3 (somewhere new: 1/1) · when you said SURE you were right 1/2.
**A click:** you got a prediction wrong before the explanation and then used the idea correctly on a case you had not seen. That reorganisation is what this is for.
**Still weak:** Wrong actor. These return first.
**New connection:** Session 4 (feedback loops): a late-night habit is a reinforcing loop; a commitment device is how you cut the loop at its cheapest point.
**Use it this week:** Protecting being more productive: an app limit is on; nobody checks; exception: only for a real emergency, reported to my friend.
